candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method only sets the new password and updates the user. It never calls sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }), so existing sessions stay valid. A device that was already signed in can keep calling refresh, because AuthService.refreshToken looks the session up by id and hash and still finds it.
